arguments:
{"content":"#!/bin/bash
# Reproducible LaTeX build script.
# Produces bit-for-bit identical /app/document.pdf for a given SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH.
set -euo pipefail

SRC_TEX="/protected/document.tex"
SRC_BIB="/protected/references.bib"
OUT_PDF="/app/document.pdf"
BUILD_DIR="/tmp/latex-repro-build"

# --- Sanity checks for input files ----------------------------------------
if [ ! -f "$SRC_TEX" ]; then
    echo "ERROR: LaTeX source not found: $SRC_TEX" >&2
    exit 1
fi
if [ ! -f "$SRC_BIB" ]; then
    echo "ERROR: Bibliography file not found: $SRC_BIB" >&2
    exit 1
fi
if ! command -v pdflatex >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "ERROR: pdflatex not found in PATH" >&2
    exit 1
fi
if ! command -v bibtex >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "ERROR: bibtex not found in PATH" >&2
    exit 1
fi

# --- Reproducible timestamps via SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH -------------------------
# If SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH is missing or empty, fall back to the current time so
# the build still completes (but warn that output will not be reproducible).
if [ -z "${SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH:-}" ]; then
    echo "WARNING: SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH is not set; using current time (build will not be reproducible)." >&2
    export SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH
    SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH="$(date +%s)"
fi

# Validate: must be an integer (seconds since epoch).
if ! [[ "$SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]; then
    echo "ERROR: SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH must be an integer (seconds since epoch), got: '$SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH'" >&2
    exit 1
fi
export SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH

# FORCE_SOURCE_DATE makes TeX Live (pdfTeX/LaTeX) honor SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH for
# \today/\year\month\day, \pdfcreationdate/\pdfmoddate, CreationDate/ModDate,
# and the PDF trailer ID. TZ/LC_ALL remove timezone/locale nondeterminism.
export FORCE_SOURCE_DATE=1
export TZ=UTC
export LC_ALL=C
export LANG=C
export ZERO_AR_DATE=1

# --- Isolated, cleaned build directory -------------------------------------
# A fixed path cleaned on every run keeps the build deterministic and avoids
# stale .aux/.bbl/.bcf state leaking between runs.
rm -rf "$BUILD_DIR"
mkdir -p "$BUILD_DIR"
cp -f "$SRC_TEX" "$BUILD_DIR/document.tex"
cp -f "$SRC_BIB" "$BUILD_DIR/references.bib"
cd "$BUILD_DIR"

# Remove any stale artifacts (defensive; dir is fresh).
rm -f document.pdf document.aux document.bbl document.blg \
      document.log document.out document.toc document.lof document.lot

# --- Compilation: pdflatex -> bibtex -> pdflatex -> pdflatex ----------------
# -interaction=nonstopmode keeps logs parseable; -halt-on-error surfaces
# invalid LaTeX syntax as a nonzero exit (set -e aborts the build).
echo "==> pdflatex (pass 1)"
pdflatex -interaction=nonstopmode -halt-on-error document.tex

echo "==> bibtex"
# bibtex returns nonzero on missing entries/warnings; the PDF is still
# producible, so warn but continue to the remaining passes.
if ! bibtex document; then
    echo "WARNING: bibtex reported an error (missing entries?). Continuing with remaining pdflatex passes." >&2
fi

echo "==> pdflatex (pass 2)"
pdflatex -interaction=nonstopmode -halt-on-error document.tex

echo "==> pdflatex (pass 3)"
pdflatex -interaction=nonstopmode -halt-on-error document.tex

# --- Install result ----------------------------------------------------------
if [ ! -f "$BUILD_DIR/document.pdf" ]; then
    echo "ERROR: pdflatex did not produce document.pdf" >&2
    exit 1
fi
cp -f "$BUILD_DIR/document.pdf" "$OUT_PDF"
echo "Built $OUT_PDF (SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH=$SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH)"
","path":"build.sh"}
